definitions.explanation: A formal celebration or the act of congratulating someone on a joyous occasion. Used for official and ceremonial contexts such as national holidays, achievements, and milestones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{祝賀|しゅくが}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{祝賀|しゅくが}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛大|せいだい}→盛大：13644_seidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A grand celebration party was held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝賀|しゅくが}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧し、⟦{広場|ひろば}→広場：00104_hiroba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わい→賑わい：26838_nigiwai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: Many citizens participated in the New Year celebration events, and the plaza was bustling.

notes:
USAGE: {祝賀|しゅくが} is a formal word used for official celebrations and ceremonies. In everyday conversation, ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧ is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝賀|しゅくが}{会|かい} (celebration gathering/reception)
- {祝賀|しゅくが}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧ (celebration party)
- {祝賀|しゅくが}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧ (celebratory event)
- {祝賀|しゅくが}⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧ (celebratory mood)
- {祝賀|しゅくが}⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧ (celebration ceremony)

SIMILAR WORDS: Compare with ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧ (congratulatory speech), which is the address given at a celebration. {祝賀|しゅくが} refers to the celebration itself, while ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧ is one element within it.
